read.description: Reads a file and returns its contents.

path.description: The path to the file to be read.

max_length.description: The maximum number of characters to read (default: 1000)

path.description: The path to the file to be written to.

content.description: The content to write to the file.

shell.description: Executes a command and returns its output (if no errors) or error message (if an error occurred)

timeout.description: The maximum time to wait for the command to complete (default: 30 seconds)
